correctness.rationale: Every nontrivial diagonal translation has precisely the p invariant perfect matching simplex interiors, with only the barycenters fixed; a fixed point must have support on one entire vertex orbit F_a. Local real normal rep is reduced p-cycle permutation module, with free lens-space sphere link L(p;1,...,(p−1)/2) dimension p−2 and H1=C_p, H2=0. Removing disjoint invariant neighborhoods leaves simply connected U (relative groups vanish up through degree two) and H2(U)=0 for p≥7 or Z/3 for p=5 from published chessboard results. The free quotient Y=U/C_p has π1=C_p, H2(Y)=H2(U) from Cartan–Leray, with no incoming H3(C_p)=Z/p map to Z/3. Each lens boundary inclusion induces an isomorphism on π1; adjoining p cones kills π1 by Van Kampen. Mayer–Vietoris exact sequence identifies H2 as extension by kernel ((Z/p)^p→Z/p), which is (Z/p)^(p−1), and coprime primary splitting for p=5. Hurewicz gives π2. Independent full face enumerations: p5 1545 faces, exactly 5 invariant facets, quotient χ=−7; p7 130921 faces, exactly 7 invariant facets, quotient χ=−23. These corroborate but cannot prove π2 universally.
